name: Firezone Starter Free Zero Trust Access
free_limit: Free Starter plan for up to 6 users and 10 service accounts; includes native clients, email/OpenID Connect authentication, resource-level access policies, audit logs and REST API.
watch_out: Firezone operates the hosted control plane but gateways are deployed on your infrastructure, which may incur hosting/network costs. Paid Team/Business features and Enterprise trial are separate. Verify usage restrictions and commercial-use terms before production; no credit card is required for Starter.
